# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 56 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 11 tokens; Radius — 6 tokens; Shadow — 4 tokens; Size — 9 tokens; Breakpoint — 3 tokens; Blur — 3 tokens; Opacity — 3 tokens; Tempo — 5 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--paper);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the night value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | night | day | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paper` | #f5f4f0 | #f5f4f0 | Neutral (added). Day bg: web pages in light mode, print stock simulation. |
| `surface` | #1c1c1c | #ffffff | Cards, list rows, tab bar. |
| `surface-raised` | #262524 | #ffffff | Sheets, menus, anything above a card. Day relies on shadow-float. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the night value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | night | day | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #f7f5f0 | #1c1c1c | Primary text on bg, surface, surface-raised and glass (14:1+). Also the PRIMARY button fill (white pill in night, as on the onboarding "Next"). |
| `ink-muted` | #b5b1aa | #6b6761 | Secondary text: metadata, supporting lines — on bg, surface, surface-raised (5:1+). |
| `ink-faint` | #8e8a83 | #6b6761 | Tertiary text (timestamps, counters) on bg and surface only; night 4.5:1 fails on surface-raised — use ink-muted there. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px. Branding face: Plus Jakarta Sans. Display, title and section are Jakarta; only the brand-owned display line takes the lowercase + yellow full stop. Numeral stays DM Sans. UI face: DM Sans for everything people read and tap. Sentence case, -2% tracking.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-poster);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `poster` | `.poster`, `--text-poster` | 144px / 0.95 | 700 | `display` | Posters and social covers on a 1080 canvas. |
| `hero` | `.hero`, `--text-hero` | 64px / 1 | 700 | `display` | Web hero, social headlines, venue hero name. |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 32px / 1.08 | 700 | `display` | The one screen headline ("this week in pune."). Plus Jakarta Sans 700. One per screen, and the only text above 22px in the app. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 20px / 1.2 | 600 | `display` | Sheet titles, venue name on detail, the feature card title. |
| `section` | `.section`, `--text-section` | 16px / 1.3 | 600 | `display` | Feed section headers ("Near you"), Plus Jakarta Sans 600, sentence case, with a subtle "See all" pill. |
| `numeral` | `.numeral`, `--text-numeral` | 96px / 0.9 | 300 | `sans` | Rank numbers, big stats, countdowns. Light weight so size does the shouting. |
| `eyebrow` | `.eyebrow`, `--text-eyebrow` | 13px / 18px | 500 | `sans` | Small context line directly above a screen or section headline, in ink-muted. It complements the headline and never competes: at most a third of its size. |
| `accent` | `.accent`, `--text-accent` | 16px / 28px | 300 | `sans` | Expression zone only (onboarding, social, posters): the light italic lead-in above a big headline. In the app use eyebrow instead. |
| `lead` | `.lead`, `--text-lead` | 20px / 28px | 300 | `sans` | Intro lines under a display headline; landing paragraphs. |
| `headline` | `.headline`, `--text-headline` | 16px / 22px | 600 | `sans` | Item titles: card and row names, 15–16px DM Sans 600. Organiser event names are written as the organiser wrote them, with no gathr full stop. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Default app text. |

### Font files

Fonts: `tokens.css` loads each font from its file, by path.

- **Design canvas:** copy `tokens.css`, `fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2`, `fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-700-normal.woff2`, `fonts/dm-sans-latin-300-normal.woff2`, `fonts/dm-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2`, `fonts/dm-sans-latin-500-normal.woff2`, `fonts/dm-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2`, `fonts/dm-sans-latin-700-normal.woff2`, `fonts/dm-sans-latin-300-italic.woff2` and `fonts/dm-sans-latin-400-italic.woff2` to the same paths under the canvas’s `project/ds/<folder>/` (`<folder>` is the folder you install this system under; `fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2` lands on `project/ds/<folder>/fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2`), in the same call that installs this system. Link that copy of `tokens.css` in the artboard’s `<head>` as `ds/<folder>/tokens.css`, or as Design’s instructions say for an artboard in a folder. If the install’s reply leaves a font out, bring that font in as for any other page.
- **Slides deck:** for each family you use in the deck (`faces` holds at most the number of typefaces Slides’ `deck-files.md` gives), install its file with the system and name the path it lands on as that family’s `src` in `project/deck.json` `faces`, under the key in the Slides column. A deck takes a font as a file only under the rule in Slides’ `fonts.md` (no space or leading underscore in its path, for two): any other font, or one kept by id, is uploaded as `fonts.md` says.
- **Any other page:** one file per family is enough (below: the upright face nearest regular weight; bold and italic synthesize). Fetch it as the fetch column says (Artifact tool `read`, that id or path as `path`), upload it as an asset (`publish`, `file_path`, `asset:true`) and declare it with an `@font-face { font-family: "<family>"; src: url(<uploaded>) }` rule.

`tokens.css` carries the `@font-face` rules for a page that links it and names each family by the CSS variable below.

| family | file | fetch | CSS | Slides `faces` key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Plus Jakarta Sans | `fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2` (weight 600) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-display)` | `plus-jakarta-sans` |
| DM Sans | `fonts/dm-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2` (weight 400) | `read` the file with `project/` in front | `var(--font-display)` | `dm-sans` |

Every face: `fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2` (Plus Jakarta Sans, 600), `fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-700-normal.woff2` (Plus Jakarta Sans, 700), `fonts/dm-sans-latin-300-normal.woff2` (DM Sans, 300), `fonts/dm-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2` (DM Sans, 400), `fonts/dm-sans-latin-500-normal.woff2` (DM Sans, 500), `fonts/dm-sans-latin-600-normal.woff2` (DM Sans, 600), `fonts/dm-sans-latin-700-normal.woff2` (DM Sans, 700), `fonts/dm-sans-latin-300-italic.woff2` (DM Sans, 300, italic), `fonts/dm-sans-latin-400-italic.woff2` (DM Sans, 400, italic).

## Spacing

4px base. App gutter space-4 (16px); floating glass bars sit space-4 from the edges; social/print safe margin 64px on a 1080 canvas. Rhythm: 32–44px between sections, 8–14px inside a group.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (11)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label, dot-to-word. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Between chips; inside badges. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Inside a group (8–14px): lines in a card, list row padding. |
| `space-4` | 16px | App side gutter; card padding. |
| `space-5` | 20px | Sheet padding. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Between cards / groups. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Between sections: 32px minimum. |
| `space-11` | 44px | Between sections: 44px maximum on feeds. |
| `space-12` | 48px | Web section inner spacing. |
| `space-16` | 64px | Social/print safe margin at 1080px; web section breaks. |
| `space-24` | 96px | Landing page section breaks on desktop. |

## Radius

Soft everywhere: pills for anything tappable, big friendly corners on cards (the music-app and App Store references), circles for icon buttons and avatars.

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-xs) */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-xs` | 6px | Crowd-meter segments, tiny tags. |
| `radius-sm` | 10px | Inputs inside sheets, small thumbnails. |
| `radius-md` | 16px | Row thumbnails, collage photos (with a 3px white edge), search field. |
| `radius-lg` | 24px | Venue and event cards, rank cards. |
| `radius-xl` | 32px | Feature cards, sheets (top corners), social story frames, phone-shaped canvases. |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | Buttons, chips, badges, tab bar, vibe tags, icon buttons, avatars. |

## Shadow

Night uses light, not shadow: glass edges, one glow, and the aurora. Day uses soft shadow.

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-card) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-card` | inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff0f · day: 0 1px 2px #1c1c1c14, 0 2px 8px #1c1c1c0f | Solid cards at rest. |
| `shadow-glass` | inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff26, inset 0 0 0 1px #ffffff14, 0 12px 32px #00000080 · day: inset 0 1px 0 #ffffffcc, inset 0 0 0 1px #ffffff99, 0 12px 32px #1c1c1c1f | Every glass surface: the top highlight, the hairline edge and a soft drop. |
| `shadow-float` | 0 12px 32px #000000b3 · day: 0 12px 32px #1c1c1c29 | Solid floating layers: menus, toasts. |
| `focus-ring` | 0 0 0 2px #0a0a0a, 0 0 0 4px #fbff87 · day: 0 0 0 2px #f5f4f0, 0 0 0 4px #531aff | Keyboard focus: 2px ground gap, then 2px solid focus colour. |

## Breakpoint

Mobile-first. The app is designed at 390; web scales up.

### Use

```css

```

| `bp-tablet` | 768px | Web: two-column venue grid. |
| `bp-desktop` | 1200px | Web: max content width 1200, three-column grid. |

## Tempo

Motion explains a change. Durations as CSS times. Nothing loops except the 3D stickers bobbing, and everything stops under reduced motion.

### Use

```css
/* var(--dur-fast) */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dur-fast` | 120ms | Presses. |
| `dur-base` | 200ms | Chips, tabs. |
| `dur-slow` | 320ms | Sheets, cards entering. |
| `dur-screen` | 360ms | Screens slide in on forward and back; tabs cross-fade. |
| `bob` | 3200ms | 3D stickers bob gently (±4px). The only looping motion; decorative. |
